modmenu.descriptionTranslation.where_win: Adds fuller vanilla grass coverage to grassy biomes.
where_winds_blow.config.title: Where Winds Blow
where_winds_blow.config.terrain.tooltip: World generation settings for Where Winds Blow grass patches.
where_winds_blow.config.wind.tooltip: Shared simulation settings for wind direction, strength, weather, and calm periods.
where_winds_blow.config.rendering.toolti: Shared client-side visual settings for clear weather, wind, foliage, smoke, and renderer compatibility.
where_winds_blow.config.rain.tooltip: Rainfall appearance, squalls, and rainy-weather wind response.
where_winds_blow.config.thunder.tooltip: Thunderstorm wind response and rain turbulence.
where_winds_blow.config.sandstorms.toolt: Blowing sand, severe desert storms, and sand-colored visibility fog.
where_winds_blow.config.snow.tooltip: Snowfall movement, blizzards, and whiteout intensity.
where_winds_blow.config.group.worldgen.d: Controls the added grass, fern accents, and wild wheat patches placed in newly generated chunks.
where_winds_blow.config.group.interactiv: Controls how nearby moving entities bend supported foliage.
where_winds_blow.config.group.windSimula: Controls the shared atmospheric wind state used by every visual effect.
where_winds_blow.config.group.dynamicDir: Controls how long the prevailing flow holds and how far it can gradually turn.
where_winds_blow.config.group.lulls.desc: Controls smooth calm periods that let foliage, smoke, lanterns, and signs settle.
where_winds_blow.config.group.gusts.desc: Controls bounded wind fronts that travel across the world and affect nearby systems in sequence.
where_winds_blow.config.group.localExpos: Controls cached, direction-aware shelter and subtle high-altitude wind scaling.
where_winds_blow.config.group.biomeProfi: Controls data-driven biome multipliers loaded from wind profile resources.
where_winds_blow.config.group.advanced.d: Development and diagnostic controls for the wind simulation.
where_winds_blow.config.group.foliage.de: Controls the custom shader used for responsive foliage rendering.
Controls bright highlights that travel across responsive foliage as the wind moves.
where_winds_blow.config.group.foliageCol: Controls subtle, coherent color variation across broad regions of responsive plants.
where_winds_blow.config.group.windMotion: Controls wind-driven plant and leaf sway plus smooth or stepped plant animation.
where_winds_blow.config.group.rainRespon: Controls the wind intensity, foliage sway, and sheen reached at full rain.
where_winds_blow.config.group.rainfall.d: Controls atmospheric rain visibility, wind-driven slant, and stream variation.
where_winds_blow.config.group.rainSquall: Controls bursts of heavier rain carried by gust fronts and softened by lulls.
where_winds_blow.config.group.blowingSan: Controls shader-driven sand and red-sand dust during rainy desert and badlands weather.
where_winds_blow.config.group.sandstormF: Controls when desert weather reduces visibility, independently from blowing dust.
where_winds_blow.config.group.severeSand: Controls the dust profile reached as thunder develops into a full sandstorm.
where_winds_blow.config.group.thunderRes: Controls the wind intensity, foliage sway, and sheen reached at full thunder.
where_winds_blow.config.group.thunderRai: Controls how turbulent individual rain streams become as thunder strengthens.
where_winds_blow.config.group.snowfall.d: Controls atmospheric snow visibility and wind-driven drift.
where_winds_blow.config.group.snowFog.de: Controls when snowy weather reduces visibility, independently from snowfall and blizzard particles.
Controls blowing surface snow and rooftop spindrift during severe snowy weather.
where_winds_blow.config.group.clearWeath: Controls baseline wind intensity, foliage sway, and sheen under clear skies.
where_winds_blow.config.group.precipitat: Controls the shared atmospheric renderer used by the Rain, Sandstorms, and Snow tabs.
where_winds_blow.config.group.ambientWin: Controls the shared renderer and overall amount for wind lines, drifting leaves, and flower petals.
Controls the density, opacity, and thickness of visible lines carried by the wind.
where_winds_blow.config.group.windLeaves: Controls drifting leaf particles sampled from nearby trees and biome colors.
where_winds_blow.config.group.windFlower: Controls flower petals carried through eligible plains and flower-rich biomes.
where_winds_blow.config.group.tumbleweed: Controls wind-blown dead bushes in deserts and badlands.
Controls how campfire smoke bends, stretches, and curls with the wind.
where_winds_blow.config.group.hangingDec: Controls wind-driven motion for lanterns, hanging signs, and standalone chains.
where_winds_blow.config.group.banners.de: Controls vanilla-style wind movement for standing and wall banners.
where_winds_blow.config.group.compatibil: Controls renderer integration and shader-pack behavior.
where_winds_blow.config.enableDenseGrass: Turns this mod's added grass world generation on or off. Requires a world reload and only affects newly generated chunks.
where_winds_blow.config.denseGrassDensit: Multiplies dense short grass generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.mediumGrassDensi: Multiplies medium short grass generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.sparseGrassDensi: Multiplies sparse short grass generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.tallGrassPatchMu: Multiplies tall grass patch generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.fernAccentPatchM: Multiplies coherent vanilla fern accent passes in forest, taiga, and jungle biomes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.shortDryGrassPat: Multiplies short dry grass patch generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.tallDryGrassPatc: Multiplies tall dry grass patch generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.deadGrassPatchMu: Multiplies dead grass patch generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.overgrownGrassPa: Multiplies overgrown grass patch generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.wildWheatPatchMu: Multiplies wild wheat patch generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.enableFoliageInt: Lets nearby entities press supported foliage aside and leave smooth directional wakes as they move.
where_winds_blow.config.foliageInteracti: Scales how strongly supported foliage reacts when entities move through it.
where_winds_blow.config.enableCustomFoli: Uses Where Winds Blow's custom foliage shader for vanilla cutout foliage render types.
Enables the bright moving sheen that travels across responsive foliage in the wind.
where_winds_blow.config.windSheenStrengt: Scales the visible intensity of the wind sheen highlight.
where_winds_blow.config.enableFoliageCol: Adds subtle, stable color variation across broad regions of responsive plants without changing their models or textures.
where_winds_blow.config.foliageColorVari: Scales broad plant color regions and finer local variation.
where_winds_blow.config.foliageAnimation: Chooses continuous plant motion or staggered stepped updates.
where_winds_blow.config.foliageSteppedRa: Sets how many visible plant animation updates occur per second in stepped mode.
where_winds_blow.config.enableWindStreak: Adds sparse wind lines, biome-tinted leaves, and eligible flower petals that drift through the air.
where_winds_blow.config.windStreakVisibi: Scales the overall amount of visible wind, including lines, drifting leaves, and flower petals.
Scales how many wind lines spawn.
where_winds_blow.config.enableWindLeaves: Adds drifting leaf particles that match nearby tree leaves and the surrounding biome.
Scales how many drifting leaf particles spawn.
where_winds_blow.config.enableWindFlower: Adds rose, dandelion, and azure bluet petals to non-snowy plains and flower-rich biomes.
where_winds_blow.config.windFlowerPetalD: Scales how many flower petals ride the wind.
where_winds_blow.config.enableTumbleweed: Occasionally sends dead bushes rolling through deserts and badlands. Rain, thunder, gusts, and stronger wind increase their activity.
where_winds_blow.config.tumbleweedDensit: Scales how often wind-blown dead bushes appear in desert and badlands biomes.
where_winds_blow.config.windStreakOpacit: Scales how opaque wind lines are.
Scales how opaque drifting leaf particles are.
where_winds_blow.config.windFlowerPetalO: Scales how opaque wind-blown flower petals are.
where_winds_blow.config.windStreakThickn: Sets the wind line width. Each line uses a soft halo around a finer bright core.
where_winds_blow.config.windDirectionDeg: Sets the fixed or prevailing wind direction in compass degrees clockwise from north. 0 is north, 90 is east, 180 is south, and 270 is west.
where_winds_blow.warning.iris.label: [WARNING]
where_winds_blow.warning.iris.body: Where Winds Blow is intended for gameplay without Iris or shader packs. Many visual features will not work while Iris is installed.
where_winds_blow.config.enableDynamicWin: Enables slow atmospheric strength variation, direction changes, and lulls. Disabling it retains weather-scaled fixed wind.
where_winds_blow.config.windDirectionMod: Lets the prevailing direction evolve over time or remain fixed at the configured compass bearing.
where_winds_blow.config.overallWindStren: Scales the strength produced by the shared wind simulation without changing individual effect settings.
where_winds_blow.config.dynamicDirection: Scales how far dynamic wind may wander during an ordinary direction change.
where_winds_blow.config.minimumDirection: Minimum number of seconds before the simulation chooses a new direction target.
where_winds_blow.config.maximumDirection: Maximum number of seconds before the simulation chooses a new direction target.
where_winds_blow.config.maximumOrdinaryD: Limits normal direction changes in degrees. Severe storms can rarely turn farther.
Allows smooth calm periods that reduce every system's shared wind input.
where_winds_blow.config.windLullFrequenc: Scales how often calm periods occur. Zero prevents them.
where_winds_blow.config.windLullStrength: Sets how much normal wind remains at the calmest point of a lull.
where_winds_blow.config.enableGustFronts: Allows up to three coherent gust bands to travel through the visible world at once.
where_winds_blow.config.gustFrequency.to: Scales how often gust fronts form. Rain and thunder naturally increase their frequency.
where_winds_blow.config.gustStrength.too: Scales the extra wind force carried by travelling gust fronts.
Sets the average speed of gust fronts in blocks per second.
where_winds_blow.config.gustWidth.toolti: Sets the average width of each gust band in blocks.
where_winds_blow.config.turbulenceStreng: Scales controlled crosswind, flutter, smoke curl, and leaf tumbling around the main flow.
where_winds_blow.config.enableWindDebugO: Shows a compact live readout of direction, strength, gusts, turbulence, and exposure.
where_winds_blow.config.enableLocalWindE: Reduces wind continuously behind walls, roofs, and foliage using a shared short-lived cache.
where_winds_blow.config.windExposureRadi: Sets how many nearby blocks the bounded upwind shelter pattern samples.
where_winds_blow.config.altitudeWindInfl: Scales the subtle wind increase toward the top of the current dimension's build range.
where_winds_blow.config.enableBiomeWindP: Applies reloadable biome-specific strength, gust, turbulence, direction, and altitude behaviour.
Lets campfire smoke drift, curl, and merge into larger wind-shaped plumes.
where_winds_blow.config.windSmokeStrengt: Scales how strongly campfire smoke follows the wind and plume turbulence.
where_winds_blow.config.enableWindLanter: Lets hanging lanterns and vertical chain blocks sway with the wind. Rebuilds visible chunks when changed.
where_winds_blow.config.windLanternSwayS: Scales how strongly hanging lanterns and vertical chains respond to wind.
where_winds_blow.config.enableWindHangin: Lets hanging signs sway back and forth with the wind.
where_winds_blow.config.windHangingSignS: Scales how strongly hanging signs respond to wind.
where_winds_blow.config.enableWindReacti: Lets standing and wall banners respond to the same local wind as foliage, smoke, lanterns, and signs.
where_winds_blow.config.bannerWindStreng: Scales how far wind lifts the banner from its resting angle.
where_winds_blow.config.bannerGustRespon: Scales the extra whole-banner motion produced by travelling gust fronts.
where_winds_blow.config.bannerFlutterStr: Scales small, quick movement of the banner cloth.
where_winds_blow.config.bannerSagStrengt: Scales how strongly banner cloth prefers to hang downward.
where_winds_blow.config.bannerTurbulence: Scales irregular banner sway caused by local turbulence.
where_winds_blow.config.bannerAnimationD: Sets how far from the camera advanced wind-reactive banner cloth is rendered.
where_winds_blow.config.enableStandalone: Lets vertical chain stacks sway even when they do not end in a hanging lantern.
where_winds_blow.config.enableSodiumShad: Adds Where Winds Blow wind uniforms and source injections to Sodium's own terrain shader.
where_winds_blow.config.enableWindFoliag: Enables wind-driven sway in the responsive foliage shader.
where_winds_blow.config.enableWindPlantS: Enables wind-driven movement for grass, crops, flowers, and other plant-like foliage.
where_winds_blow.config.enableWindLeafSw: Enables wind-driven movement for leaf blocks.
where_winds_blow.config.enableWindReacti: Uses Where Winds Blow's precipitation renderer. Disable this to restore vanilla rain and snow rendering.
where_winds_blow.config.enableDesertStor: Turns rainy desert and badlands weather into sand- or red-sand-tinted windstorms. Thunder adds matching tan or rust-colored visibility fog.
where_winds_blow.config.sandDustAmount.t: Scales airborne dust during ordinary rainy desert weather. Zero hides it; one preserves the default amount; two approximately doubles it.
where_winds_blow.config.sandDustSize.too: Scales the size of shader-driven dust clusters during ordinary rainy desert weather.
where_winds_blow.config.sandDustSpeed.to: Scales how quickly dust travels with the wind during ordinary rainy desert weather.
where_winds_blow.config.sandstormFogMode: Chooses whether desert visibility fog is disabled, limited to severe sandstorms, or active during all rainy desert weather.
where_winds_blow.config.sandstormFogInte: Scales how strongly desert weather shortens visibility without changing blowing dust.
where_winds_blow.config.sandstormDustAmo: Sets the airborne dust amount reached during a full sandstorm. The amount blends smoothly as the storm strengthens.
where_winds_blow.config.sandstormDustSiz: Sets the dust-cluster size reached during a full sandstorm. Size blends smoothly as the storm strengthens.
where_winds_blow.config.sandstormDustSpe: Sets the dust travel speed reached during a full sandstorm. Speed blends smoothly as the storm strengthens.
where_winds_blow.config.sandstormIntensi: Scales the extra density and opacity of severe sandstorms without changing ordinary blowing sand or fog.
where_winds_blow.config.enableRainEffect: Renders atmospheric rain. Disable this to hide rain while retaining the other precipitation effects.
where_winds_blow.config.enableSlantedRai: Lets rain lean in the current wind direction. Disable this to keep atmospheric rain vertical.
where_winds_blow.config.rainAngleVariati: Sets the maximum angle difference between individual rain streams during normal rain. Zero keeps every stream parallel.
where_winds_blow.config.thunderRainAngle: Sets the maximum angle difference between individual rain streams at full thunder. Storms interpolate toward this value as thunder strengthens.
where_winds_blow.config.enableDynamicRai: Makes travelling gust fronts bring bursts of denser, faster, more slanted rain while wind lulls soften the downpour.
where_winds_blow.config.rainSquallStreng: Scales how strongly gusts and lulls change rain density, speed, opacity, and tilt.
where_winds_blow.config.enableSnowEffect: Renders atmospheric snowfall. Disable this to hide snow while retaining the other precipitation effects.
where_winds_blow.config.enableWindDriven: Lets snow drift and flutter in the current wind. Disable this to keep atmospheric snow vertical.
Scales falling snowflakes during ordinary snowfall. Zero hides them; one preserves the default amount; two approximately doubles it.
where_winds_blow.config.snowflakeSize.to: Scales the size of falling snowflakes during ordinary snowfall.
where_winds_blow.config.snowflakeSpeed.t: Scales how quickly snowflakes fall during ordinary snowfall.
where_winds_blow.config.blizzardSnowflak: Sets the falling snowflake amount reached during a full blizzard. The amount blends smoothly as the storm strengthens.
Sets the snowflake size reached during a full blizzard. Size blends smoothly as the storm strengthens.
Sets the snowflake fall speed reached during a full blizzard. Speed blends smoothly as the storm strengthens.
where_winds_blow.config.snowFogMode.tool: Chooses whether snowy-weather visibility fog is disabled, limited to blizzards, or active during all snowfall.
where_winds_blow.config.snowFogIntensity: Scales how strongly snowy weather shortens visibility. This does not change snowfall density or blowing snow.
where_winds_blow.config.enableBlizzardEf: Adds low blowing snow over exposed snow-covered ground and rooftops during severe snowy weather.
where_winds_blow.config.blizzardIntensit: Scales the density of blowing snow and rooftop spindrift without changing ordinary snowfall or fog.
where_winds_blow.config.windFoliageSwayS: Scales the strength of wind-driven foliage motion.
where_winds_blow.config.windPlantSwaySta: Raises the still base of grass, crops, flowers, and other plant-like foliage. Higher values reduce wind sway on simple crossed-plane plants. Rebuilds visible foliage when changed.
where_winds_blow.config.clearWeatherWind: Sets the weather wind power used during clear weather. This affects foliage gust intensity, wind streak density, and wind smoke.
where_winds_blow.config.rainWeatherWindP: Sets the weather wind power reached at full rain. This affects foliage gust intensity, wind streak density, and wind smoke.
where_winds_blow.config.thunderWeatherWi: Sets the weather wind power reached at full thunder. This affects foliage gust intensity, wind streak density, and wind smoke.
where_winds_blow.config.clearWeatherSway: Sets the minimum foliage sway strength during clear weather.
where_winds_blow.config.rainWeatherSwayS: Sets the minimum foliage sway strength reached at full rain.
where_winds_blow.config.thunderWeatherSw: Sets the minimum foliage sway strength reached at full thunder.
where_winds_blow.config.clearWeatherShee: Sets the minimum wind sheen strength during clear weather.
where_winds_blow.config.rainWeatherSheen: Sets the minimum wind sheen strength reached at full rain.
where_winds_blow.config.thunderWeatherSh: Sets the minimum wind sheen strength reached at full thunder.
